name: Spore Code
description: Spore Code (CLI) integration: /api/spore-code/auth + /api/spore-code/sessions HTTP routes (the Go-binary protocol contract), session:start / session:end WS handlers, the Spore Code settings pane, the project-context + plan-mode prompt sections, the webapp self-register team-key gate, and the graph_update temp-tagging middleware. Depends on session-graph for the underlying session-node persistence + note_discovery tool + recall-skip heuristic + per-turn breadcrumb helpers. Uninstall to disable Spore Code entirely; uninstall session-graph first if it has no other dependents.
